purpose: Teach: 完備/部局/蓄え/出向い/改築/仮設/通さ/まずまず

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新店舗、設備、本気で、完備、絶対、お客様、満足、いただけますわよね、本気で、楽しみよ、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: The new store will be fully equipped, and our customers will absolutely be satisfied. I'm genuinely looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm, measured confidence. Opens crisply. Speaks as someone who has earned the right to optimism. Slight emphasis on the certainties — equipment, satisfaction. Trailing comfort at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社の各部局、本気で、連携、強化しております、絶対、本当に、社員、頑張ってくれて、感謝、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Every department at headquarters is strengthening coordination across the board. Our staff have been working incredibly hard, and I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Responds with the cadence of someone reporting upward but meaning it. Steady pace. Lands firmly on the gratitude — not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 災害時の備蓄、本気で、当社、蓄え、社員、皆、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本当に、安心ですね、本気で。
lines.en: Our disaster preparedness stockpiles are in good order, and I'm genuinely grateful for how seriously every staff member has taken this. It's reassuring.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective than the first line. Speaks from genuine relief. Slightly slower pace. The gratitude here is deeper — safety matters. Soft close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のお宅、私、出向いた時、本気で、丁寧に、対応、心がけてまいりました、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Whenever I've visited customers' homes, I've made sure to respond with care and attention to detail. That's been my commitment.
lines.style: Earnest, present. Not defensive — just steady. Opens with quiet attention. Describes his approach without overselling it. Lands on the commitment with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社屋の改築、本気で、来年から、進めましょうね、絶対、本気で、社員、皆、楽しみに、しております、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The building renovation will begin next year, and our staff are genuinely excited about it. Let's move forward together with confidence.
lines.style: Clear, directive but warm. Opens with fresh energy. Speaks with the authority of someone setting direction, but includes the team. Slight rise on the announcement, settles on the shared momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仮設の作業場、本気で、災害復興、活用できますね、絶対、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、皆、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. The temporary workspace is being put to good use in our disaster recovery efforts, and I'm grateful for how well it's serving us.
lines.style: Steady, practical. Acknowledges the difficulty beneath without dwelling on it. Measured pace. The gratitude is genuine but grounded — this is what work looks like right now.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、横道に、通さないように、しっかり、ご案内しましょうね、絶対、本気で、お願い、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Customers should be guided carefully to the main areas — let's make sure we're directing them properly, without exception.
lines.style: Warm but purposeful. Leader speaking to trusted staff. Opens with clear intent. Measured, not rushed. The request lands gently but firmly — she knows they'll understand why this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期、まずまずの、成績、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、社員、皆、頑張ってくれて、本当に、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. This quarter's results have been solid, and I want to thank everyone. The whole team has been working so hard, and it truly shows.
lines.style: Genuine, closing warmth. Meets her eye to eye in tone. Slow enough to land each phrase — solid results, the gratitude, the team's effort. Sincere without ceremony.
